description:
When an opponent controls a nontoken creature, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, The Serpent Society triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
When the opposing creature(s) die, Overseer of the Damned triggers that many times, creating that many tapped 2/2 Zombie creature tokens that will have deathtouch due to Archetype of Finality.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat as needed.
